brief_title: Study Of Two Dosing Regimens Of PF-04937319 Compared To An Approved Agent (Sitagliptin) In Patients With Type 2 Diabetes
official_title: A Phase 1b, Randomized, Double-blind, Active Comparator Controlled, 3-period, Cross-over Study To Characterize The Pharmacodynamics And Tolerability Of Two Dosing Regimens Of Pf-04937319 In Adults With Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus Inadequately Controlled On Metformin

primary_outcomes.measure: Change From Baseline in Weighted Mean Daily Glucose (WMDG) at Day 14
primary_outcomes.time_frame: Prior to morning dose (Hour 0) and at 1.5, 3, 5, 6.5, 8, 11, 12.5, 14, 16, 20, and 24 hours post morning dose on Days 0 (baseline) and Day 14

brief_summary: Study B1621019 will assess efficacy and safety of two different dosing regimens of an investigational agent (PF-04937319) compared to an approved drug (sitagliptin) in patients with type 2 diabetes

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with type 2 diabetes, on background metformin therapy either alone or with 1 other oral anti-diabetic agent (excluding Actos)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with cardiovascular event within 6-months of screening
* Patients with diabetic complications
* Female subjects who are pregnant or planning to become pregnant
* Subjects with unstable medical conditions (eg, hypertension)
